title: Count the Stars
paragraphs: Abram was an old man with no children when God told him to leave his country and go to a land that God would show him, and promised that all the families of the earth would be blessed through him. So Abram packed up, left his home, and went, without a map. One night God took him outside and said, "Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them." And God said, "So will your offspring be." Abram looked at the huge, glittering sky and believed. He couldn't see how it would happen. But he trusted the one who promised. Many hundreds of years later a child would be born from that long line, and the blessing was meant for everyone, not just one family.
wonder: I wonder what it's like to trust someone when you can't see the road?
activity: Go out on a clear night (or look at a star map) and try to count. Or cut paper stars.
prayer: God of the stars, help us to trust you even when we cannot see the way. Amen.
alt: A traveller with a staff gazes at a sky full of stars joined by a golden thread.
hidden: One star is larger than the rest.
translation: Retold in our own words, with short quotations from the World English Bible.
